description: Source code for broadcastEvent module responsible for generating and broadcasting watchdog events via IPC, including initialization, shutdown, and event broadcasting functions.

methods.name: startWatchdogEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the event producer for watchdog events if not already initialized.

methods.name: stopWatchdogEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the event producer for watchdog events if active.

methods.name: broadcastWatchdogEvent
methods.description: Creates and broadcasts a watchdog event with specified code, value, and name to listeners.
